intro: Verog the Dervish is an elusive Kolkar centaur leader who roams the southern plains of the Barrens. To put an end to his raids, Regthar Deathgate directs Horde champions to raid the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis, forcing the nomadic commander into the open.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The centaur Verog the Dervish wanders the Barrens, and will be difficult to find. But he is based at the centaur command tent at the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast. It may be possible to draw him to you.
Travel to the Stagnant Oasis to the southeast and attack centaur near the command tent. It will be dangerous, but if you can kill enough centaur then they should raise an alarm. And Verog will come.
Bring me his head and I will place it with Barak Kodobane's.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Very good. You must have really stirred up those centaur -- our guards spotted activity down near the Stagnant Oasis, which was probably you.
You should be proud of your deed, friend. There is much bravery in you.
